item.tib: 'jigs byed gshin rje gshed kyi brnag pa 'chi bdag gshin rje khros pa'i las rim phung byed nag po
item.coloph: bdag 'dra rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyi me 'brug zla 8 tshes 26 bzang poRa gyim shod shel brag tshal gyi shar phyogs seng ge g.yu ral rtse nas gter du spyan drangs/ slar lo bcu gsum dang zla ba bzhi zhag bzhi yi bka' rgya yol nas sa 'brug zla 12 tshes 30 bzang por shog ser las zhal bshus nas/ yi ge pa ni 'phrin las lhun grub can gyi byas pa'i dge des zab mo'i bstan pa 'di 'gro don nyi 'od sa steng du gsal te bkra shis bstan pa 'bar gyur cig sa 'brug zla 8tshes la zhal bshus dge zhing bkra shis//
